en: A black and white photograph of an old fortified stone building with a steep, shingle roof and thick walls. The structure has small, square windows and an external stone staircase leading up to an entrance. The foreground shows a rough road, and there is another building partially visible on the right side. The image has a historical feel, and the construction style suggests a European setting. The watermark indicates it is from a university library collection.
